name: Atrium Chandelier
summary: Three-tier modern ring chandelier with 24 faceted pendant drops and a compact ceiling plate.
description: Original P2 atrium hanging ornament for the GJH Virtual Mall. Three concentric warm-white light rings, 24 crystal-like drops, nine suspension rods and a ceiling plate; no text, brands or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and three shared materials; no external models, textures, fonts or images. No random inputs.

interface.runtime: Static emissive visual asset. LIGHT_Ring is available for scene-owned lighting controls or selective Bloom. Raise the root so the ceiling contact reaches the desired mall ceiling height; no floor stand is included.

accuracy_notes: Dimensions and statistics are measured from the delivered GLB. Floor-centre origin is the unplaced module datum at its lowest pendant tips; the ceiling plate is above it. Short, smoke-blue crystal-like drops use opaque reflective facets to avoid transmission and transparency passes. Emission is a material effect; Bloom, scene illumination, suspension engineering, collision and electrical behavior belong to the consuming scene. Full mall integration, the scene-wide 200 draw-call budget, physical mobile devices and WebKit are not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and three shared materials; no external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
